title: Maps+ probe - heat, feature and marker layers across refreshes (MP-03, MP-04)
description: Probe harness. H: two heat layers, the second visible. H2: both heat layers hidden at load. See test/README.md.

viz_h.title: H - heat layers heatA (visible) and heatB (layerVisibility=false), 1 feature, 5 markers (MP-03, MP-04)

viz_h2.title: H2 - both heat layers layerVisibility=false, 1 feature, 5 markers (MP-03, MP-04)

ds_h.name: H heat plus feature plus markers

options.query: | makeresults | eval feature="34.02,-118.30;34.02,-118.20;34.08,-118.20;34.08,-118.30", featureLayer="zone", layerDescription="Zone polygon", layerVisibility="true", heatmapInclude="false" | append [| makeresults count=200 | streamstats count as n | eval latitude=34.05+(random()/2147483647-0.5)*0.1, longitude=-118.25+(random()/2147483647-0.5)*0.1, heatmapLayer=if(n<=100,"heatA","heatB"), heatmapInclude="true", layerDescription=heatmapLayer, layerVisibility=if(n<=100,"true","false"), markerVisibility="false"] | append [| makeresults count=5 | streamstats count as m | eval latitude=34.05+(m-3)*0.012, longitude=-118.25, tooltip="Marker ".m, markerType="circle", heatmapInclude="false", layerGroup="Markers", layerDescription="Markers", layerVisibility="true"] | table feature featureLayer layerDescription layerVisibility heatmapLayer heatmapInclude latitude longitude markerVisibility tooltip markerType layerGroup
